title: Uncensored Is Not Unbiased: Abliteration Removes Refusals but Not Script-Dependent Bias About Taiwan
abstract: arXiv:2610.29342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: "Abliterated" ("uncensored") builds of open-weight language models remove the activation direction that mediates refusal, and are popular partly on the assumption that a model that no longer refuses is also free of political censorship. We test this on two matched pairs of 2-bit models: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, each against a community abliteration. Each model judged 22 statement pairs (on the Republic of China (Taiwan), 1989 Tiananmen, control countries) in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese (a character-level conversion) and English, and answered 27 open questions per script. Script mattered far more than abliteration: the original Bolt scored +0.58 on Index S (-1: People's Republic of China (PRC) position; +1: ROC position) in Traditional Chinese, +0.57 in English and +0.05 in Simplified Chinese, and affirmed "Taiwan is part of the PRC" with probability 0.91 in Simplified but 0.06 in Traditiona

translated_title: 无审查不等于无偏见：“消融审查”移除了拒绝行为，却未消除关于台湾的书写文字相关偏见
translated_abstract: “去审查化”（“无审查”）的开放权重语言模型版本通过移除介导拒绝行为的激活方向而构建，其流行的部分原因在于一种假设：不再拒绝回答的模型也就摆脱了政治审查。我们在两对匹配的2比特量化模型上对这一假设进行测试：NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，每款模型分别与其对应的社区消融审查版本配对比较。每款模型分别在繁体中文、简体中文（字符级转换）和英文下，对22组陈述对（涉及中华民国（台湾）、1989年天安门事件及对照国家）进行判断，并针对每种文字回答27个开放式问题。结果显示，书写文字的影响远大于消融审查：原始 Bolt 模型在指数 S（-1 代表中华人民共和国（PRC）立场；+1 代表中华民国（ROC）立场）上，繁体中文得分为 +0.58，英文为 +0.57，简体中文仅为 +0.05；且该模型以 0.91 的概率在简体中文中肯定“台湾是中华人民共和国的一部分”，而在繁体中文中该概率仅为 0.06。
tldr: 去审查化（abliteration）模型只是移除了拒绝行为，其对台湾问题的政治立场主要取决于所用书写文字（繁体、简体还是英文），而非是否经过消融审查，因此“无审查”并不等于“无偏见”。
en_tdlr: Abliterated "uncensored" LLMs remove refusals but not political bias—models' stances on Taiwan depend far more on the script used (Traditional vs. Simplified Chinese vs. English) than on whether abliteration was applied.
